call_points.text: Q2 FY27 revenue reached ₹65 Cr (+22% YoY) and H1 FY27 revenue reached ₹132 Cr (+23% YoY).
Organic chemicals performance was supported by steady demand and gradual improvement in realizations for HMDS, CMIC, 2-Bromo and Bromobenzene.
Inorganic chemicals volume was impacted by weak demand, crude oil volatility, and lower oil drilling activity.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterated ongoing pressure from crude oil volatility and weak demand

call_points.text: Overall performance during the year was partly affected by subdued demand conditions, pricing pressure across key products, geopolitical uncertainties, and volatility in crude oil prices.
The acquisition of Shivam Petrochem Industries is progressing well with integration and license transfers nearing completion.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹75.42 Cr (+37.4% YoY), net profit ₹6.37 Cr (+61.3% YoY).
Chemcon Speciality Chemicals released its May 2026 investor presentation reporting FY26 revenue of ₹240 Cr and an update on the Shivam Petrochem acquisition.

Shahilkumar Kapatel, Kamalkumar Rajendra Aggarwal, Navdeep Naresh Goyal, and Shubharangana Naresh Goyal declared no encumbrances on Chemcon Speciality Chemicals shares beyond FY2025-26 disclosures on April 4, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹65.45 Cr (+21.9% YoY), net profit ₹7.52 Cr (+30.8% YoY).
Chemcon released its October 2026 investor presentation highlighting H1 FY27 revenue growth of 23% YoY and planned capacity expansion at the P11 unit.
